kxase01.title: When Their Texts Get Shorter
kxase01.caption:
Their texts went from paragraphs to "ok" and your brain wrote a whole drama.
Short texts usually mean a busy day, not a verdict on you. Ask kindly instead of guessing.

kxase02.title: Missing Them, Not Going Back
kxase02.caption:
Missing them at 2 a.m. doesn't mean you should go back.
Let the feeling visit, write it down, and text a friend instead. Missing someone is memory, not a map.

kxase03.title: When You Like Them More
kxase03.caption:
Planning every date while they just show up is a lonely kind of crush.
Say it kindly: are we on the same page? Then believe the answer they give you.

kxase04.title: A Crush on Your Friend
kxase04.caption:
A crush on your best friend feels like too much to risk.
Say it gently, give them room, and mean it when you say the friendship stays. Save this for the brave day.

kxase05.title: The Night Before a First Date
kxase05.caption:
First date tomorrow and your brain is running worst cases on a loop.
Pick the outfit tonight, bring three questions you're curious about, and remember: nerves mean you care.

kxase06.title: Not Feeling It, Kindly
kxase06.caption:
They're lovely. There's just no spark, and vanishing feels easier.
A warm, short, clear message lets them move on. Honest is kinder than a slow fade.
